payload.title: Plan unsupported-domain failure system decomposition
payload.rationale: One solution-independent SYS child is the smallest decomposition that can preserve the single parent commitment without duplicating its failure classes or allocating implementation structure. The child will make the failure indication assessable while remaining within the exact parent, architecture, interface, and verification-strategy boundaries.
payload.behavioral_slice: Decompose the complete STK-BN9AVKRQE9-r00001 unsupported-domain failure commitment into one system behavior allocated to FAILURE_BOUNDARY: each named failure class yields an assessable clear failure, nonzero termination, and no result value.
expected_coverage: Invalid expression shape triggers the system failure behavior.
Unsupported operator triggers the system failure behavior.
Non-finite number triggers the system failure behavior.
Division by zero triggers the system failure behavior.
Every named failure presents an assessable failure indication.
Every named failure emits no result value.
exclusions: Failure classes not named by STK-BN9AVKRQE9-r00001.
A prescribed diagnostic encoding, message text, implementation component, algorithm, storage, timing, or security mechanism.
Formal verification execution and downstream promotion.
